<b>Tarmites</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small, winged bone mites capable of spitting scorching tar at their prey.<ref>Tarmite Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Flying bone mite that lives near magma. Roasts its prey by spitting scorching tar."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
When idle, Tarmites fly idly in place. Once they've spotted Hornet, they begin pursuing her while trying to maintain distance between itself and her.<br>
Tarmites attempt to at least always be above Hornet, and vary constantly between diagonal distancing and horizontal distancing.

To attack, Tarmites spit a glob of burning tar in her direction which deals {{Damage|2|type=Fire}} ({{Damage|1|type=Fire}} with [[Magma Bell]] equipped), indicated by its eyes and mouth glowing orange beforehand. This tar can stick to surfaces and lingers for 2 seconds before dissipating.<br>
As they ready to spit, Tarmites move faster than usual in a straight line away from Hornet's general direction.<br>

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Tarmites have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

| columns = 2

* Feel its burn...

== Location ==
Tarmites can be found in the [[Far Fields]], initially inside the [[Far_Fields#Skull_Cave|Skull Cave]]. Upon the cave's completion, one Tarmite will spawn inside the cave, and two more will spawn outside.

They are also summoned by the [[Savage Beastfly]] encountered in the Far Fields.
